s1.syndrome_frame: Recurrent urinary retention and sepsis with diffuse bladder wall thickening
salient_findings: Recurrent urinary retention
Sepsis
Diffuse irregular polypoid thickening of the entire bladder wall
Diffuse bland spindle cell proliferation in the superficial bladder wall
Dense, perivascular spindle cell proliferation with cytological atypia in the deeper wall
key_facts: 50-year-old man
Known neurofibromatosis type 1
Multiple cutaneous neurofibromas
No history of smoking
Admitted for recurrent urinary retention and sepsis
Transurethral resection of the prostate revealed fibroleiomyomatous hyperplasia
Urinary function did not improve after transurethral resection
CT scan showed diffuse irregular polypoid thickening of the entire bladder wall
Cystoprostatectomy was performed due to compromised bladder function
Bladder wall was diffusely thickened, firm, and gray–white on gross examination
Near–complete loss of the detrusor muscle
Tumor cells were positive for S100, p16, neurofilaments, and CD56
Tumor cells were negative for pan-cytokeratin, EMA, MDM2, p63, ALK, CD117, DOG1, myogenin, desmin, and smooth muscle actin

shortlist.label: Malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has neurofibromatosis type 1 and tumor cells are positive for S100, consistent with MPNST

shortlist.label: Plexiform neurofibroma
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has neurofibromatosis type 1 and history of multiple cutaneous neurofibromas, with tumor cells showing spindle cell proliferation

shortlist.label: Schwannoma
shortlist.why_kept: Tumor cells are positive for S100, a marker for schwannomas, and patient has neurofibromatosis type 1

shortlist.label: Nerve sheath tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Tumor is in close contact with peripheral nerves and cells are positive for S100 and neurofilaments

shortlist.label: Leiomyosarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Diffuse irregular polypoid thickening of the bladder wall and tumor cells show spindle cell proliferation with cytological atypia

raw.rationale: The tumor's diffuse bland spindle cell proliferation with cytological atypia, frequent mitoses, and an infiltrative growth pattern, along with its positivity for S100 and neurofilaments, are consistent with a malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor, especially in the context of neurofibromatosis type 1.

rejected.label: Plexiform neurofibroma
rejected.why: While the patient has neurofibromatosis type 1, the tumor's histologic features and immunohistochemical profile are more suggestive of a malignant process than a benign plexiform neurofibroma.

rejected.label: Schwannoma
rejected.why: Schwannomas are typically benign and do not exhibit the cytological atypia and frequent mitoses seen in this tumor.

rejected.label: Nerve sheath tumor
rejected.why: This is a broad category that includes both benign and malignant tumors; the specific features of this tumor are more consistent with a malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor.

rejected.label: Leiomyosarcoma
rejected.why: The tumor's immunohistochemical profile, including negativity for smooth muscle actin, does not support a diagnosis of leiomyosarcoma.
